question: What is the largest 6-digit number divisible by 52?
solution:
**Calculations:**

The largest 6-digit number = 999999

Dividing 999999 by 52 gives the quotient as 19230 and 39 as the remainder,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab83528887206535d7decadec4819bcadeaeda611cdf5c76bc908650fe721f32.png] 

Now the largest 6-digit number divisible by 52

⇒ 999999 = 19230 × 52 + 39 (remainder 39)

⇒ 999999 - 39 = 999960

**∴ The largest 6-digit number divisible by 52 is 999960.**
